body: Still open when AUDIT.md was retired (6 Nov 2026; the file is now the frozen section `audit` of docs/history/reviews-2026-10-31.md): R2-F3: Home shows "[Unknown Album]" cards for songs with no album || **RC1 for the display layer** (PR #136, built, not walked: unit and widget tests only, no device has shown it); the cause is later | The display rule (`app/lib/domain/album_names.dart`, one predicate) now covers: Home shelves (the bucket is dropped), the album names (Home, Library, artist page, the all-albums grid, the artist's release row, the media browser and its "playing from" name) as "Songs without an album", and every song row, cover, queue, player and lock-screen album line (shown as a song with no album); the bucket's own page no longer asks the catalogue what it is "missing". Left (small): the Library sorts the bucket by its raw name (it lands at the top of an A-Z list), searching "unknown" still finds it, and the song menu still offers "Go to album" for a song that now shows no album. The rule lives in the app today; the server's rulebook (P2-23) should own it so a browser, a TV app or any other client gets it for free. The cause: the Spotify import reader carries title, artists and length only and builds no album, and nothing fills it in (the YouTube Music reader does read albums); fix = P2-12 (fill from a strong song match, tag the file, backfill, rescan), held until `b11` (D-51)
